name: Pixeltable Docs
summary: Hosted MCP server for the Pixeltable documentation. Search the docs and read pages for Pixeltable, the open-source Python library for multimodal AI data: tables, computed columns, embedding indexes, and AI integrations. Read-only, public content, no account or API key needed.
setup_instructions: Connect this listing in Open Dots. No authentication is required. The server exposes search_pixeltable_documentation (search the docs), query_docs_filesystem_pixeltable_documentation (read documentation pages), and submit_feedback (send feedback about a docs page). Grant only the tools each agent needs; search and read are enough for answering Pixeltable questions. Documentation: https://docs.pixeltable.com
test_instructions: Grant search_pixeltable_documentation to an agent and call it once with a short query such as "create a table with an embedding index". A successful call returns matching documentation pages with titles, URLs, and excerpts. Remove the grant if the agent does not need the search tool.
